get.description: 读取当前学校的可展示目录投影，当前内容权限在每次请求时检查。课程须在服务端截止学期（默认 2023 秋）及以后有开课记录。kind=term 仅返回截止学期及以后且有可见课程的学期，按 term_order_key 降序、ID 升序分页；前端保持返回顺序。其他类型按 ID 升序。 体育项目作为 kind=course 条目返回 course_type=sports_project。按项目 course_id 查询教师、教学班与开课，筛选计数按项目去重。

Requires current content admission in the served school: valid campus eligibility or verified teacher status. Missing admission returns 403; unavailable required facts return 503. No preview, content, counts or statistics are returned on rejection. 教师公开查询由服务端目录标记过滤：有授课记录或已匹配官网名单即可保留。列表、详情、批量查询、筛选选项及计数使用相同依据。未标记的教师详情返回 not_found。 Courses outside the current visible directory projection return not_found, including direct links.

post.description: Imports at most 500 objects and enrollment records atomically. An identical idempotency key and payload returns the original result while the import record is retained, including retries after 24 hours. The same key with different content is rejected.

get.description: 只返回当前用户的有效选课，按 term_order_key 倒序、选课 ID 升序。未知学期键为 0。after 绑定本人且须符合当前筛选，返回后续记录。

get.description: Login and ownership only. Returns names for IDs referenced by the caller own current or historical enrollment records; current content admission is not required. An unowned requested ID rejects the entire request with 404. At most 100 IDs. This response never includes biographies, scores, schedules or other public detail.

parameters.name: include_term_order
parameters.description: 在选课对象中返回 term_order_key。默认 false，保留旧客户端的封闭 Enrollment 结构。返回顺序始终按结构化时间倒序。

get.description: Complete term export, at most 100 enrollments and 10000 occurrences; unavailable if exceeded. 422 schedule_incomplete when any meeting time, required period or timetable is missing, or local time is ambiguous/nonexistent. UTC DTSTART/DTEND correctly derived from IANA timezone. Stable UID per subject/term/class/meeting/week. No partial calendar.
Requires catalog maintain capability and school scope. Missing configuration returns 404.

put.description: Requires catalog maintain capability and school scope. Missing configuration returns 404.

get.description: Current visible course/teacher directory, stable sort with ID tie-break and filter-bound cursor. Categories count distinct courses after all filters except category_id. Department groups respect all current filters. Classification filters apply to the same offering/class. Teacher rows and counts require T2 persisted marking; absent marker enforcement returns 503. Scores are read in bounded batches from owning modules, without per-row queries. Catalog membership is cached with transactional revision invalidation; ratings and heat are always current. 目录成员和分面来自同一持久投影版本，实时评分与热度按 ID 关联。游标绑定投影版本，重建后使用旧游标返回 409，应从第一页重新读取。

Owner-only, current-readable courses visited in the last 90 days, newest first, at most 20. Only owner key, course ID and server visit time are persisted. Expired/invisible courses are excluded immediately. Resource counts are live, batched and current-visible; a disabled resource provider is explicitly unavailable.

delete.description: Idempotently clear only the authenticated owner. Current school eligibility is not required to erase personal history.

put.description: Record a current-readable course using server time. Per-owner serialization preserves the newest 20 unique canonical courses and removes expired records. Repeated visits replace the timestamp; request payloads cannot set an owner or time.

get.description: Uses the current owner enrollment source and a separate server-side permission to display enrollment summaries. Missing display permission or source authorization returns unavailable without course data.
读取与公开列表相同投影版本的筛选选项，只返回数量大于零的项。课程截止学期、内容状态、学校和教师标记均已应用；当前内容权限在每次请求时检查。

Requires catalog.teacher-sites.read and current school management scope. Every view is audited. Latest run includes safe failure code and observed request/site counts; unknown measurements are null. Counts reflect current visible teacher marks.

post.description: Requires catalog.teacher-sites.refresh and current school management scope. Audited durable enqueue. Only one queued/running refresh globally; a competing request returns 409. Replay with the same actor, school, key and mode returns the original run; a different mode conflicts. Deadline is 45 minutes including queue time. Manual full and incremental are supported; monthly scheduler only enqueues incremental.

202.description: Accepted; asynchronous durable job. Poll status.

get.description: Requires catalog.teacher-sites.read and current school management scope. Every view is audited. Current complete unmatched snapshot only; failed refresh preserves it. Returns public website name/unit, fixed reason and count of same-name catalog candidates, never candidate IDs, staff numbers or contacts. reason_counts covers the entire snapshot; total respects reason. Cursor binds school, reason and snapshot revision; a changed snapshot returns 409. Sorted by site_id.

term_order_key.description: 结构化时间排序键，与截止学期使用同一规则：自然年 × 10 + 季节（春 1、夏 2、秋 3），例如 20243 表示 2024 秋。不是学年起始年份。学期选项按键倒序、ID 升序；公开目录投影不返回无法解析的学期。

latest_term_id.description: 课程在当前目录投影中最近一次开课的学期 ID，按结构化学期排序键确定。

course_type.description: 体育项目使用 kind=course 和稳定的项目 ID。普通课程省略此字段。项目详情、教师、学期及评价复用课程接口；编号体育课程原 ID 返回不存在。

sports_project_code.description: 仅教学班导入使用的来源体育项目代码。由学校适配器读取明确字段，目录规则通过配置将代码映射到项目；不从场地或教师推断。

term_order_key.description: 选课学期的结构化排序键，与 Object.term_order_key 相同。0 表示来源缺失或无法解析，排在已知学期后。列表按此键倒序、选课 ID 升序；after 仍传上一页最后一个选课 ID。 仅 include_term_order=true 的 HTTP 请求返回。

clear_credits.description: Explicitly restore unknown credits; cannot be combined with credits.

course_count.description: 当前目录投影中关联的可展示课程数量。

teacher_count.description: 当前目录投影中关联的可展示教师数量。

offering_count.description: 截止学期及以后纳入当前投影的开课记录数量。

ScheduleTime.description: ISO weekday Monday=1. Explicit week set; odd/even weeks are expanded by importer. End period >= start. Missing structure means not provided. Recognized time_text grammar: 周一 第1-2节 第1-16周(单), with optional 单/双 suffix.

Timetable.description: School and term scoped. PUT revision 0 creates; subsequent writes require current revision. Duplicate identical PUT with previous revision returns stored result. Period numbers unique and increasing with nonoverlapping same-day times.

review_count.description: Sum of visible review_count values for distinct directory objects in this facet. A review attributed to several teachers contributes to each teacher. Category facets exclude category_id itself; department facets retain all current filters.

facet_total.description: Distinct objects after all filters except category_id, for the All category badge.

site_id.description: 仅用于列表标识和分页的不可逆摘要，不返回官网原始标识、教师工号或候选教师 ID。
